notes: rect = [x, y, w, h] in DIALOG UNITS (MS Sans Serif 8). Use UIA BoundingRectangle at run time; the DLU->pixel factor is roughly 1.5 x 1.625 at 96 DPI, times 1.25 for this 125 % display.

style "(hidden)" = WS_VISIBLE not set in the template (shown at run time only when the code enables it).

Dialogs 111/112/113/114 and 427/428/489 are property PAGES: OK/Cancel/Apply belong to the parent CPropertySheet (IDOK=1, IDCANCEL=2, ID_APPLY_NOW=12321) and the tab control is AFX_IDC_TAB_CONTROL=12320.
Optional "note" key on controls carries the operator guidance; all other keys follow the requested schema.
selection = "requested" (the 18 dialogs asked for) or "keyword-scan" (other dialogs mentioning X-Ray/Warm/Shutter/HV/Abort/Stop/Continue/Home/Init/Collect/Password/Login/User).

prompts.text: HASP not found !
prompts.context: Start-up: Sentinel HASP dongle (VID_0529) not detected; XrdWin will not run normally.
prompts.who_answers: CLAUDE may dismiss (pure information; log the text first). If in doubt, HUMAN.

prompts.text: HASP Device Driver not installed.
prompts.context: Start-up licence check.
prompts.who_answers: CLAUDE may dismiss (pure information; log the text first). If in doubt, HUMAN.

prompts.text: Can't read from HASP Device Driver.
prompts.context: Start-up licence check.
prompts.who_answers: CLAUDE may dismiss (pure information; log the text first). If in doubt, HUMAN.

prompts.text: Incorrect Password
prompts.context: Login dialog 173 / password dialog 204: wrong password. Claude never types passwords; the human retries.
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN

prompts.text: Cannot delete the admin user
prompts.context: Set the Password dialog (205).
prompts.who_answers: CLAUDE may dismiss (pure information; log the text first). If in doubt, HUMAN.

prompts.text: Do you want to delete the user %s?
prompts.context: Set the Password dialog (205), Delete user.
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN

prompts.text: Do you want to change the project with the current one?
prompts.context: Login / Choose Project: project folder switch under C:\XrdWin Data.
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN

prompts.text: Do you want to change the application's main folder to: %s?
prompts.context: Project path change (registry Projects Path).
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN

prompts.text: Do you want to load the %s configuration?
prompts.context: Start-up/Initialize: a configuration matching the system serial number was found.
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN

prompts.text: Cannot find the serial number in the configuration
prompts.context: Start-up/Initialize configuration load.
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN (information box, but it reports hardware / X-ray / interlock state)

prompts.text: A new version (%d) is available for download. Do you want to proceed?
prompts.context: Help > Update / start-up update check (network download).
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN

prompts.text: Cannot open the language file!
prompts.context: Start-up language resource.
prompts.who_answers: CLAUDE may dismiss (pure information; log the text first). If in doubt, HUMAN.

prompts.text: Simulation-Enabled.
prompts.context: Start-up when registry Simulation=1 (it is 0). Means hardware I/O is faked; README: no safe simulation mode.
prompts.who_answers: HUMAN (information box, but it reports hardware / X-ray / interlock state)

prompts.text: Initialization - in progress ...
